name: Unit Armament Holding

fields.label: Armament
fields.description: What the unit holds. The holding is a row, not a column: one unit holds many kinds of armament, each with its own quantity and condition.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Serviceability, from the closed list in `military/vocab.py` (`HOLDING_CONDITIONS`).

description: The source's `unit_armament` table: one row per (unit, armament), with a uniqueness constraint and a positive-quantity check. Owned repeated data of a unit, so a child table — and the unique pair becomes the child-table rule in the controller.
